messages.subject: Re: tags$button in server.R
parts:
My guess is that you've defined your own copy of `tags` somewhere else in your code. You should be able to work around that by explicitly naming the package that it's from, as in `htmltools::tags$button`

On Wed, Jan 14, 2015 at 12:46 PM, Adam A <a.bassai...@gmail.com> wrote:
I'm trying to add the function bellow to server.R but I'm getting the following error: 'Error in tags$button : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors'

Here is the function:
  actionButton2 <- function(inputId, label, btn.style = "" , class = "", icon = NULL) {
   
    if (!is.null(icon))
      buttonContent <- list(icon, label)
    else
      buttonContent <- label
   
    if ( btn.style %in% c("primary","info","success","warning","danger","inverse","link")) {
      btn.css.class <- paste("btn",btn.style,sep="-")
    } else btn.css.class = ""
   
    print("class(tags) = ")
    print(class(tags))
   
    tags$button(id=inputId,
                type="button",
                class=paste("btn action-button",btn.css.class,class,collapse=" "),
                buttonContent)
  }

Any idea how to avoid this error?

Thanks
